_meta.source: Compiled from published Amazon India seller fee-update articles (March 2026 revision). NOT yet cross-checked per-ASIN against SP-API's live Product Fees API.
_meta.verify_next: Once SP-API access is connected (BLUEPRINT.md Milestone 0), calibrate every field below against the real fee-preview response for a few actual candidate ASINs and update this file.
_meta.zero_referral_note: Effective 16 Mar 2026, Amazon India waived referral fee entirely on items priced <= Rs.1000 across 1800+ categories. Closing fee and weight-handling fee still apply below this threshold.

weight_handling_fee_easy_ship.note: Zone = Local (same city/state) / Regional (nearby states) / National (rest of India).

fba_pick_pack_fee_rupees.note: Per-unit fee only. Monthly storage fee is separate and not per-unit (see fba_storage_fee_per_cuft_month) — enter your own per-unit storage estimate if you want it folded into a single product's margin.
